beats.say: Twenty-eight to three. Third quarter. In the Super Bowl.
No team had ever come back from more than ten points in a Super Bowl. Ever.
beats.cap: No team had EVER come back from more than *10.*

scene.label: BIGGEST SUPER BOWL COMEBACK BEFORE THIS

beats.say: To win, New England needed twenty-five straight points. Including two two-point conversions. They got all of it.
beats.cap: They needed *25 straight points.* Two *2-point conversions.* They got *all of it.*

beats.say: The pass gets tipped... and Edelman catches it off a defender's leg. Inches from the grass.
beats.cap: The pass gets *tipped...* caught *inches from the grass.*

beats.say: Fifty-seven seconds left. Tied. Twenty-eight. Twenty-eight.
First overtime in Super Bowl history. Atlanta never touched the ball.
beats.cap: First OT in Super Bowl history. Atlanta *never touched the ball.*

beats.say: Joe Buck: Patriots win the Super Bowl! Brady has his fifth!
beats.cap: *Patriots win the Super Bowl!* Brady has his fifth!

scene.quote: PATRIOTS WIN THE SUPER BOWL! BRADY HAS HIS FIFTH!

title: T-Mac's 13 in 33

beats.say: Down eight. Forty-four seconds left. The Spurs had it won.
Houston needs nine points just to win. In forty-four seconds.
Tracy McGrady. Three.
Three again. And the foul. Four-point play.
Three. Down two, eleven seconds left.
Then he steals it. From twenty-six feet...
Bang. Rockets eighty-one, Spurs eighty.
Thirteen points in thirty-three seconds. Is anything more clutch?
beats.cap: *13 points in 33 seconds.* More clutch than this?

ask: More clutch than 13 in 33? Name it 👇

title: The Kick Six

beats.say: Number one Alabama. Number four Auburn. Tied at twenty-eight. One second left.
Alabama tries a fifty-seven yard field goal to win it.
beats.cap: Alabama tries a *57-yard* field goal to win.

beats.say: It's short. Chris Davis is waiting, nine yards deep in the end zone.
beats.cap: It's *short.* Chris Davis waits *9 yards deep.*

beats.say: And he just... keeps... running.
And on the radio: Auburn's gonna win the football game!

scene.quote: AUBURN'S GONNA WIN THE FOOTBALL GAME!

beats.say: Touchdown. No time left. Auburn wins.
About a hundred and nine yards. End zone to end zone. The Kick Six.

scene.label: YARDS · END ZONE TO END ZONE

title: The Minneapolis Miracle
ask: Craziest last play ever? Comment yours 👇

beats.say: Saints up one. Ten seconds left. Playoffs. No timeouts.
ESPN gave Minnesota about a three percent chance.
Third and ten. The plan: a catch, get out of bounds, kick a field goal.
beats.cap: The plan: *catch it,* get out of bounds, kick it.

beats.say: Diggs catches it at the thirty-four... and the tackle misses.
He's gone. Touchdown. No time left. Vikings win.
On the radio: Are you kidding me? It's a Minneapolis Miracle!
beats.cap: Are you kidding me? *It's a Minneapolis Miracle!*

scene.quote: ARE YOU KIDDING ME?! IT'S A MINNEAPOLIS MIRACLE!

beats.say: The first playoff game ever won on a touchdown as time ran out.
beats.cap: First playoff game won on a TD *as time ran out.*

Overtime. Oklahoma scores on the very first play.

title: The Comeback

Down thirty-two. Their star quarterback is hurt. Backup Frank Reich is in.
beats.cap: Down *32.* Star QB hurt. *Backup Frank Reich.*

beats.say: Then Buffalo scores. And scores. And scores. And scores again.
beats.cap: Buffalo *scores. And scores. And scores.* And again.

Houston kicks a field goal. Tied. Overtime.
Interception. Then a field goal. Bills win.
Thirty-two points. Still the biggest comeback in NFL playoff history.

title: Cavs come back from 3–1

beats.say: Cleveland. Down three games to one in the Finals.
Against the Warriors. Seventy-three and nine. The best record ever.
Cleveland wins game five. Then game six. Game seven, in Oakland.
Tied at eighty-nine. Under two minutes left. Iguodala on the break...

Then Kyrie Irving. A three, right over Curry.
Cavs win. The first team ever to come back from three-one down in the Finals.
